title: Preaching of the Word
definition: Preaching of the Word is the public proclamation and explanation of Scripture for the glory of God and the building up of His people.
summary: God nourishes and governs the Church through His preached Word.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is proclaimed as Lord, Savior, and fulfillment of Scripture through faithful preaching.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Preaching of the Word teaches that Christ does not redeem people into isolation but into a gathered, accountable, worshiping, serving, and mission-shaped people. The Church belongs to Jesus, is formed by the Gospel, and is strengthened by the Word, prayer, ordinances, fellowship, and Spirit-empowered service.

This doctrine helps believers see the Church as more than a place to attend. It is the household of God, the body of Christ, and a visible witness to the grace, holiness, unity, and truth of the Lord.

The specific emphasis here is god nourishes and governs the church through his preached word.. A healthy church life displays Christ's care for His people and His mission to the world.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because many people treat church as optional, consumer-driven, or disconnected from discipleship. Preaching of the Word calls believers back to Christ's design for His people, where worship, truth, love, accountability, service, and mission are held together.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Participate in church life with humility and faithfulness. Let preaching of the word move you to serve, forgive, gather, pray, give, submit to Scripture, care for others, and help the body of Christ grow in love and maturity.
